titles.title: Evening Star

description: A point of yellow light glows at the upper lefthand corner of the composition. A pale red halo of light expands from the yellow star. Below, a band of dark blue extends across the bottom third of the composition.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
